summary: I run Vision Development, a four-week program from DreamIt LiveIt for young people in foster care. They look at what they're good at and what matters to them, and they finish with a few practical steps toward what they want.
audience: Young people in foster care, signed up by the foster or kinship parent or other carer who looks after them. Caseworkers can point carers our way, and they have nothing to set up.
problem:
Before: so much gets decided for them. Questions about after high school get a shrug. "He just shuts down." "She says I don't know to everything."
After: someone has asked what they want. They have their values in their own words, a picture of the future they want and a few action steps they chose themselves.
moments:
Questions about life after high school just get a shrug.
Their carer wants them to have something to aim at.
They've had plenty of adults with plans for them and they've shut down.
A caseworker is asked what's out there and what it costs.
offerings:
Vision Development, a four-week program from DreamIt LiveIt with Elizabeth Mgaya
Self-awareness and identity: who they are and where their strengths lie
Their values, put in their own words
A vision of the future they want, with practical action steps toward it
howItRuns:
Four weeks, Thursdays 10:30 to 11 a.m. Eastern, on Zoom.
The carer books the free 15-minute call with the NowTRANSFORMED team, any time in the next three weeks. For anyone under 18, a parent or carer must be on it. The young person can join and just listen.
After the call: the carer talks it over with the young person. If it fits, the team explains how sign-up works, which adults need to agree and the next start date.
faqs:
Q: Who can sign a young person up?
A: The adult who cares for them books the free call. If they're under 18, a parent or carer must be on it. Ask on the call what's needed to enrol them and whose consent comes first, and keep their caseworker in the loop.

Q: When and where is it?
A: Thursdays, 10:30 to 11 a.m. Eastern, for four weeks, on Zoom. Ask about the next start date on your free call.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: You'll get the exact price on your free call. If you're a good fit, you may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship toward this offer.

Q: They're done with programs.
A: That's fair, and they don't have to decide now. They can join the free call and just listen.

Q: How do I know this is legitimate?
A: Good to check. DreamIt LiveIt is my business, and the free call is run by NowTRANSFORMED, a youth leadership development program. If a caseworker would like to talk with me first, I'm glad to.
aboutYou:
I'm Elizabeth Mgaya. I started DreamIt LiveIt because I believe a big change in life doesn't have to be the end of your story.
My own path through career, family responsibilities, caregiving, unexpected life changes and starting over has shaped how I help others find purpose in the middle of a transition. Today I bring together coaching, mentoring, life experience and practical tools for young people and caregivers.
Your current circumstances are part of your story, but they do not have to determine your future.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
Never promise outcomes for a young person: no jobs, grades, school admissions or changes to their placement.
No details about any young person's case or situation.
Never suggest a young person can enrol without the adults who need to agree.
